[返回论文笔记](index.qmd)

选一个主题，查看对应各期荐读。

```{=html}
<div id="question-topics" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3" role="group" aria-label="按问题分类筛选荐读">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="" aria-pressed="true">全部</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="刺激参数与剂量" aria-pressed="false">刺激参数与剂量</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="脑活动与脑网络" aria-pressed="false">脑活动与脑网络</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="认知与睡眠" aria-pressed="false">认知与睡眠</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="安全与临床转化" aria-pressed="false">安全与临床转化</button>
</div>
<script>
  const questionTopics = document.querySelectorAll("#question-topics button");
  const selectedQuestionTopic = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("category") || "";
  for (const button of questionTopics) {
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(button.dataset.topic === selectedQuestionTopic));
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.topic)));
      for (const option of questionTopics) {
        option.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(option === button));
      }
    });
  }
</script>
```
